scope: Explicit native scheduler and synchronization checks supplement existing THREAD/WORK/SIMD diagnostics.

implementation.ownership: Spectra owns selection and common text/NDJSON/explicit export. Bounded privileged native work stays with sched/kernel_check and existing task_probe/sync owners.
implementation.shared_cases: Reuse bounded mutex/event ping-pong, all four IF on/off sleep/event cases, directed role wakes, fairness, priority inheritance, and original normal/deadline DriverWork IRQ/YMM cases. Share 65-task creation/enrollment with the isolated timeout case. Add missing native guarded-semaphore and recursive UnwindGuard ownership assertions.
implementation.lifetime: A CAS gate serializes boot/live state. One resident BSP controller retains exact own task generations until actual exit and retirement, and exact work tickets until real completion/cancellation plus release. AP callers get immutable output through a release/acquire handoff. The original caller unwind token spans waits and output; no runtime owner spans a blocking operation. Missing acknowledgments keep the exact resident session and block new runs.
implementation.deadlines: Live checks use actual absolute deadlines with own task callbacks; no fake clock advancement, global timer-mode changes or foreign queue reset. The deterministic 64+1 timeout batch, direct one-shot reprogramming, global reserve metadata failure and global boot priority latency stay isolated and are advertised in the result.
implementation.interface: Append-only R4DEV v16 slot49 after unchanged 408-byte prefix, total416. New ProgramKernelSchedulerCheck v1 fixed128. Contract0.64.13 and SDK0.64.25 use exact published pins; all existing slots/types/constants preserved. Invalid selection/header/capacity leaves output unchanged; larger buffer tail is checked.
implementation.selection: CHECK THREAD /KERNEL[:SYNC|SCHED|FPU|ADMISSION]. Existing default THREAD/WORK/SIMD behavior is unchanged. ADMISSION requests only the small shared sync body from two own callers and proves one owner, one busy and real userland join.
implementation.common_unwind: Move the unchanged exact-task Admission guard from heap_check to sched/task_context; heap and scheduler diagnostics share it.
implementation.exact_assertions: Recursively acquire/release the own mutex with exact owner generation/depth. Prove semaphore timeout with real elapsed ticks. Priority inheritance checks the private own mutex, exact holder generation, waiter dispatch rank and live inherited-rank counter, followed by its actual return to zero; foreign global counters cannot substitute for this proof.
implementation.retirement_receipt: Keep the diagnostic last pin until the native lifetime owner atomically claims exact dead-task teardown. Pending retains the pin; only synchronous resource and metadata free acknowledgment counts as retired. An explicit retained failure is sticky and never converted to success by registry absence or retried through a possibly reused pointer. The common native release path returns its exact claim unwind token under brief runtime admission and checks the return; no runtime owner spans resource or metadata teardown. This also closes an unprotected counter mutation in ordinary task cleanup.
implementation.boot_failure: Any failed legacy boot probe keeps the exclusive gate even if a best-effort cleanup reports completion; public callers cannot reset shared state while an old failed probe might still retain references.
